name: Forced displacement
summary: About 50,000 fled Ethiopian clashes into Kenya's Moyale since late October; no new 500,000 event found as of 12 Nov
state: A rapid assessment by Kenyan authorities with IOM support, reported on 10 Nov, puts the number who fled clashes in Ethiopia's Moyale area into Kenya since late October at about 50,000 (AllAfrica). This is well below the 500,000-in-a-month Watch line. Searches on 12 Nov found no single new displacement event of that scale; displacement in Sudan and Yemen is long-running rather than new.
for_you: Most directly affects people crossing from southern Ethiopia into northern Kenya, who need food, water and shelter. Large new displacements tend to strain host areas and aid budgets; UNHCR and IOM publish figures.
rubric_hit: Normal: largest new event ~50,000 people (Moyale), below the 500,000-in-a-month Watch line

sources.title: AllAfrica — Families who fled Ethiopia for Kenya's Moyale need food, water and shelter

why: Over 120 million people are forcibly displaced; new mass displacement drives regional instability and migration politics.
